story.setting: The film takes place in a windowless Paris studio after dark, presented vertically in 9:16. A black stone plinth stands at the center of a seamless charcoal backdrop; its polished top catches a restrained reflection without becoming a mirror. A tall, faceted smoked-glass perfume bottle with a brushed gold cap stands near the front edge. A matte-black presentation carton sits behind it to the left, with no visible lettering. There are no people or animals. A narrow warm light comes from high camera-right, while a soft cool edge separates the glass from the background. The overall grade is near-black, smoky gray, and muted gold, with controlled highlights and deep, clean shadows. The final graphic occupies a separate, pure-black field.

clips.paragraph: An extreme close-up reveals the brushed gold cap of a tall, faceted smoked-glass perfume bottle with a brushed gold cap. A narrow warm highlight moves across the brushed surface, exposing its fine texture without turning it glossy. The camera slowly pulls back and lowers, following one angular glass edge toward the base. Dark facets separate into translucent planes as the light catches them. The black stone plinth enters the frame, followed by a matte-black presentation carton behind the bottle to the left. The movement settles into a centered, full-height product portrait with generous black space above.

clips.reference_why: This shot continues the preceding product portrait in the same studio and moment, preserving the bottle, packaging, and lighting geometry.
clips.paragraph: From the settled product portrait, the camera begins a slow forward move toward the tall, faceted smoked-glass perfume bottle with a brushed gold cap. The matte-black presentation carton remains behind it to the left and gradually softens out of focus. A warm strip of light travels across the front facets, briefly revealing the depth of the smoked glass. The bottle stays upright and motionless; its proportions and cap remain unchanged. The camera stops with the bottle filling most of the vertical frame, leaving breathing room around its silhouette. The highlight settles along one edge, and the image holds before a clean cut.

Center a delicate metallic-gold circular outline containing a bespoke, clearly legible thin-line "MV" monogram. Place "MAISON VERRE" beneath the circle in small, widely spaced capitals, also in restrained metallic gold. Keep the monogram and wordmark optically centered as one compact composition, surrounded by generous negative space. Use crisp, refined edges with no glow, gradients, shadows, textures, additional symbols, or other text.
clips.reference_why: A designed still is required to hold the exact monogram, circular outline, and Maison Verre wordmark consistently throughout the end card.
clips.paragraph: A clean cut reveals a pure-black field. At its center, a thin gold MV monogram sits inside a delicate gold circle. clips.prompt:
40-second luxury perfume film opening, Clip 1, vertical 9:16. Photoreal cinematography in a windowless Paris studio after dark. Tall faceted smoked-glass bottle, brushed-gold cap; narrow warm light from high camera-right, cool rim, tactile metal and glass. Hushed, slow, restrained. One continuous shot; same bottle, cap, black stone plinth and unlettered matte-black carton throughout. Bottle upright, motionless near plinth’s front edge; carton behind-left against seamless charcoal.
0–5s: extreme close-up of gold cap; warm highlight crosses fine brushing against charcoal darkness; camera creeps backward.
5–10s: tight detail of cap and shoulder; reveal descends along one angular glass edge against charcoal; camera pulls back and lowers.
10–15s: close-up of gold-capped body; translucent planes emerge, cool rim outlines glass against charcoal; camera continues backward and down.
15–20s: full-height portrait; reveal plinth’s reflection and carton behind-left; camera eases to center with black space above.
20–25s: centered portrait; warm strip begins crossing front facets, carton behind-left; camera starts slow push forward.
25–30s: medium close-up; strip reveals smoked-glass depth, carton soft behind-left; camera advances slowly.
30–35s: tight portrait; highlight settles on one edge, charcoal surrounds silhouette; camera decelerates.
35–40s: tight portrait settles with breathing room, carton blurred behind-left; camera stops by 38s, holds perfectly still through 40s, then end cut.
Audio off. Near-black, smoky-gray, muted-gold grade; controlled highlights, clean deep shadows, measured pacing. Negatives: no people, animals, lettering, glossy cap, mirror reflection, bottle deformation, next clip or final graphic.

clips.reference_why: A designed still is required to hold the exact monogram, circular outline, and Maison Verre wordmark consistently throughout the end card.

reference_used.prompt: Use generate_image to create a minimalist luxury perfume end card in vertical 9:16 format. Render a flat, front-facing graphic on a perfectly uniform pure-black background (#000000), with no perspective or camera tilt. Center a delicate circular outline horizontally, its center approximately 47% down the canvas and its diameter 30% of the canvas width. Inside it, draw a bespoke, clearly legible thin-line "MV" monogram, with balanced letter proportions, elegant geometric construction, and ample clearance from the circle. Beneath the circle, place "MAISON VERRE" on one line in small, widely spaced, refined sans-serif capitals, centered at approximately 59% of the canvas height. Keep both elements optically centered as one compact composition with generous negative space. Use a single restrained metallic-gold appearance represented by uniform flat muted gold (#B79A60), without simulated reflections or directional lighting. Keep the background, layout, lettering, and aspect ratio fixed; include no people, products, additional symbols, or other text. Require crisp vector-like edges, with no glow, gradients, shadows, or textures. Review the resulting still before using it as a video reference.

card.prompt: Use the supplied image as the starting frame and strict reference for this 5-second, 9:16 end card. Preserve the image’s exact composition, style, lighting, colors, and all existing elements in their original positions. Preserve any depicted person’s facial identity, hairstyle, and clothing without movement or alteration. Sign/card: preserve its shape, surface, placement, and existing typography; the lettering "MV" and "MAISON VERRE" must remain exactly as shown, sharp and fully readable throughout. Use the original image pixels rather than regenerating lettering; any necessary text correction belongs in a separate editing step, not this video generation. One continuous shot: hold the image almost motionless, with only a very slow, barely perceptible camera push-in over the first three seconds, increasing scale by no more than 0.5% and keeping every design element safely inside the frame. Gently settle into a completely still hold for the final two seconds, ending on the unchanged end card. Nothing in the image moves or changes. Audio off. Negatives: no cuts, subject animation, identity or anatomy changes, text morphing, relettering, added graphics, cropping, parallax, flicker, warping, lighting shifts, or sound.
